text: Program Description I. Programme Introduction The Chongqing Medical University Foundation Programme for International Students is designed for international students who intend to apply for undergraduate programmes at CQMU. The programme aims to improve their English and Chinese proficiency, strengthen their ability to study basic courses related to medicine, and help them prepare for the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA). This is a non-degree training programme for international students studying in China. II. Duration and Curriculum 1. Duration: One semester, starting in spring. The specific registration and class commencement dates shall be subject to the University's notice. 2. Teaching language: English. 3. Curriculum: The core components are English language courses and preparation courses for the CSCA (Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry). The curriculum also includes basic Chinese, adaptation to studying in China, and an introduction to China's national conditions.
